covers: rtextures.c's LoadImageAnim and LoadImageAnimFromMemory on helix-formats' test GIFs as stb_image composites them: one frame of GIF87a, rectangles kept over the screen, disposal to the background and to the previous frame (the first frame's) with transparency over it, a background index past 0 under a first frame smaller than the screen, transparency in a global and a local table, interlaced rows, 256 colors of noise filling the LZW code table, a file PIL wrote, a file of no frames, a missing file; a PNG as one frame; a name and a type known only as the program runs; the bytes typed .gif, .GIF and .png
notes: Where raylib gives an image with no data (a missing file, a GIF of no frames), LoadImageAnimAsync fails, printed as 0 frames. The PNG is RGBA: helix-ray's file images say PIXELFORMAT_UNCOMPRESSED_R8G8B8A8 whatever the file's channels.
